final_lessons: For this regression dataset, high-capacity layer-normalized MLPs can beat faster-looking optimizers even with tiny-lr Adagrad.
Adagrad at lr 0.003 with a deeper MLP beat shallow AdamW and tiny-lr SGD on this dataset.
Very wide residual MLPs can win with conservative RMSprop, and Adagrad lr 0.01 may be too aggressive for deeper models.
Adagrad lr 0.0001 underfits badly here; residual RMSprop lr 0.0001 can beat both it and SGD with weight decay.
Shallow wide Adam at lr 0.0001 underfits compared with the deep wide residual RMSprop lr 0.0001 setup.
The depth-5 width-256 mostly layer-normalized Adagrad lr 0.0003 candidate is a top performer among observed choices.
Shallow SGD lr 0.01 and narrow Adagrad lr 0.01 remain weak versus the deep width-256 Adagrad lr 0.0003 model.
A depth-4 width-256 partially layer-normalized Adam lr 0.0001 model can be strong despite weight decay, while SGD lr 0.001 is weak.
A shallow width-256 layer-normalized AdamW lr 0.01 model can be strong; no-momentum tiny-lr SGD and very narrow RMSprop are weak.
The deep width-256 residual RMSprop lr 0.0001 setup reliably beats no-momentum tiny-lr SGD and very narrow AdamW.
